editor.hint: Whatever you type is what shows. It never changes.
editor.hint2: Starts at the start value and climbs by itself within the ranges below. The figure is kept on the server, so every visitor sees the same one and a refresh does not restart it.
editor.hint3: A real figure from the database. Marked with a green dot on the site.
editor.noStatsYetThe: No stats yet. The section is hidden on the site.
editor.rightNow: Right now: {value}. Nothing to keep up to date.
editor.savingRestartsTheFigure: Saving restarts the figure from its start value.
editor.theStripAtThe: The strip at the bottom of the landing page. Each figure is one of three kinds — typed by hand, growing automatically, or a real counter from the database.
